# Pacific Marketing Solution

> Pacific Marketing Solution is a digital marketing agency based in Houston, Texas (USA). It combines SEO, AEO and GEO, paid advertising (Google Ads and Meta Ads), websites, content and creative work, AI chatbots and voice agents, CRM automation and white-label services to turn online attention into measurable growth. Pacific Marketing Solution is a startup by Unimind Studios.

Full text of every page in one file: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/sitemap.xml

Contact: info@pacificmarketingsolution.com

## Services
- [All services](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/): 22 services in four groups: Build, Create, Grow and Automate.
- [Website Development](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/website-development/): Is your website slow or not bringing calls? We design fast, mobile-first business websites in Houston and across the US. Fixed price, and you own it.
- [Shopify Stores](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/shopify-stores/): Want to sell online without fighting your store every day? We set up Shopify stores with products, payments and shipping done. See what is included.
- [WordPress Websites](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/wordpress-websites/): Plugins breaking or your developer gone? We build, fix and look after WordPress sites you can update yourself, with security and backups handled.
- [AI Websites](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-websites/): No website yet, or quotes that take months? Get a professional business site live in 3 to 7 days, built with AI and checked by a person. See the steps.
- [Custom Websites](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/custom-websites/): Outgrown off-the-shelf tools? We build client portals, booking systems, memberships and dashboards around how you work, with full source code.
- [SaaS & MVP Development](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/saas-development/): Have a software idea but no reliable team? We build MVPs and SaaS products in weekly testable releases, with Stripe billing and full code ownership.
- [Video Production](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/video-production/): Want customers to trust you before they call? We make product, promo, testimonial and explainer videos for businesses. See examples of our work.
- [Reels & TikTok Videos](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/short-form-videos/): No time to film and edit? We turn your footage into Reels and TikToks with strong hooks and captions every month, so you post without the work.
- [AI Videos & Commercials](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-videos-commercials/): Video ads cost too much to film? We make AI spokesperson, voiceover and product ads in days, in several languages. See sample AI videos.
- [Graphic Design](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/graphic-design/): DIY graphics making your business look small? We design ads, social posts, flyers and menus in one consistent style. Fast turnaround.
- [Branding & Logos](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/branding-logos/): Look like every competitor in town? We design logos and brand kits people remember, with simple rules your team can follow. See our process.
- [Social Media Management](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/social-media-management/): Posting only when you remember? We plan, post and reply to comments and DMs for you, with a monthly report on what brought customers in.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/seo/): Stuck on page two? We fix indexing, content and technical SEO so you rank for searches that bring paying customers. See our law firm case study.
- [Local SEO & Google Maps](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/local-seo/): Competitors showing up on Google Maps before you? We fix your Business Profile, reviews and local pages so nearby customers call you first.
- [Paid Ads](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/paid-ads/): Paying for clicks that never call? We run Google, Meta and TikTok ads tracked to real leads, and you keep the ad account. See real ad results.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-search-optimization/): Does ChatGPT recommend your competitors instead of you? We optimize your site and listings so ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI name your business.
- [AI Chatbots](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-chatbots/): Losing website visitors after hours? Our AI chatbots answer questions and book appointments around the clock. See what one costs and how it works.
- [AI Agents & Voice Receptionists](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-agents-voice/): Calls going to voicemail? An AI receptionist answers in seconds, books appointments and passes urgent calls to you. See how it sounds and what it costs.
- [Business Automation](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/business-automation/): Copying data between apps and chasing leads by hand? We connect your CRM, forms and calendar so follow-ups and reminders run by themselves.
- [AI Analytics Dashboards](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-analytics-dashboards/): Five reports and still no idea what is profitable? See ad spend, revenue and true profit in one live dashboard, with plain-English AI summaries.
- [Email & WhatsApp Marketing](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/email-whatsapp-marketing/): One-time customers who never return? We set up email, text and WhatsApp campaigns, reminders and offers that bring them back to buy again.
- [Custom Business Software](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/custom-business-software/): Paying for six apps that don't fit? Our Houston team builds custom CRM, booking and POS software for US businesses. Fixed quote, full source code.
- [White-label services](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/white-label-services/): Turning down client work for lack of staff? We deliver web, AI and marketing projects under your agency's brand, on your deadlines, never contacting clients.

## Learn
- [Marketing insights](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/): Straight answers on SEO, ads, AI agents and software, written from real client dashboards and builds. Short reads with the actual numbers.
- [Marketing terms explained](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/glossary/): Plain-English meanings of common marketing words such as SEO, AEO, GEO, CRM, CTR, CPC, conversion, funnel and white-label.
- [What Upwork clients say about our AI engineer](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/what-upwork-clients-say-about-our-ai-engineer/): 41 Upwork reviews, a 5.0 rating and 100% Job Success. What clients say about Nauman N., who leads our AI and SaaS builds.
- [Voice AI agents in practice: three builds and what they share](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/voice-ai-agents-three-builds/): A voice coaching platform, an AI phone receptionist and lead re-engagement calls: what our voice agent builds share, and what to plan first.
- [The tech stack behind our AI and SaaS builds](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/tech-stack-behind-our-ai-and-saas-builds/): The tools we use to build AI agents, voice agents and SaaS products, from Next.js and FastAPI to Claude, LangGraph, RAG and n8n.
- [Three SEO reports side by side: what the numbers show and what they hide](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/three-seo-reports-side-by-side/): See how three real SEO projects compare on clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position, and what each number does and does not tell you.
- [Fix indexing first: how the SEO for Allen Jacobi Law began](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/fix-indexing-before-writing-more-content/): Why search engines must index your pages before new content helps, and how fixing indexing for a law firm led to qualified leads by month three.
- [Clicks are not results: reading a Google Ads report from click to conversion](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/reading-a-google-ads-report-beyond-clicks/): Follow a $1,720 Google Ads campaign from impressions to cost per conversion, and learn why clicks alone do not show whether ads are working.
- [A $0.78 click is only good news if you can see what happens next](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/a-low-cost-per-click-needs-conversion-tracking/): A $0.78 click sounds cheap, but is it working? Learn why cost per click needs conversion tracking, using a real Google Ads campaign.
- [155,000 link clicks: what three Meta campaigns show about cost per click](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/meta-ads-cost-per-click-155000-link-clicks/): Three Meta Ads campaigns produced over 155,000 link clicks at ≈ USD 0.0059 to 0.0070 each. See what the numbers show about cost per click and scale.
- [Clicks or conversations? Choosing the right Meta Ads objective](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/clicks-or-conversations-meta-ads-objective/): How to choose between link clicks and messaging conversations on Meta Ads, with real costs from three industrial-products campaigns.
- [What clients say they value most: themes from five testimonials](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/what-clients-say-they-value-most/): We read our client testimonials for patterns. SEO results, quick replies and shared know-how came up most. Here is what clients said.
